FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask0.en: The BABY NURSERY: little POKéMON\nneed a home. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask0.fr: La PÉPINIÈRE : les petits POKéMON\nont besoin d'un foyer. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask1.en: The BARTER HOUSE: trade treasures\nfor rare POKéMON. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask1.fr: La MAISON DU TROC : échange des\ntrésors contre des POKéMON rares.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask10.en: The PEBBLE BEACH: smooth stones and\ntiny tides. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask10.fr: La PLAGE DE GALETS : pierres lisses\net minuscules marées. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask11.en: The LANTERN MEADOW: glowing flowers\nat dusk. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask11.fr: La PRAIRIE DES LANTERNES : fleurs\nlumineuses au crépuscule. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask12.en: The CRICK POND: small ripples,\nsmall friends. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask12.fr: L'ÉTANG DES GRILLONS : petites\nondes, petits amis. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask13.en: The DAISY HILL: flowers all the way\nup. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask13.fr: La COLLINE DES MARGUERITES : des\nfleurs jusqu'au sommet. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask14.en: The BERRY BROOK: a sweet stream.\nVisit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask14.fr: Le RUISSEAU DE BAIES : un cours\nd'eau sucré. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask15.en: The TUMBLEWEED TRAIL: dry wind,\nrolling bushes. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask15.fr: Le SENTIER DES VIRE-VOLTANTES :\nvent sec, buissons qui roulent.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask16.en: The FERN GULLY: a green dip full of\ntiny wings. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask16.fr: Le RAVIN DE FOUGÈRES : un creux\nvert plein de petites ailes.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask17.en: The LILY LAGOON: pads to hop and\ntiny frogs. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask17.fr: Le LAGON DES LYS : nénuphars à\nsauter et minuscules grenouilles.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask18.en: The HARVEST HOLLOW: golden fields\nand scarecrows. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask18.fr: Le CREUX DES RÉCOLTES : champs\ndorés et épouvantails. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask19.fr: La PRAIRIE BOURDONNANTE : des ailes\npartout. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask2.en: The APOTHECARY: boosters for your\nwhole team. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask2.fr: L'APOTHICAIRE : des boosters pour\ntoute ton équipe. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask3.en: The MEADOW PATH: a calm start for\nnew collectors. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask3.fr: Le CHEMIN DE LA PRAIRIE : un début\ntranquille pour les nouveaux\lcollectionneurs. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask4.en: The COTTON FIELD: soft grass,\nsleepy POKéMON. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask4.fr: Le CHAMP DE COTON : herbe douce,\nPOKéMON somnolents. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask5.en: The BREEZE HILL: wind, grass and\nfirst catches. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask5.fr: La COLLINE DE LA BRISE : vent,\nherbe et premières captures.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask6.en: The DROWSY DOWN: sleepy hills full\nof dozing POKéMON. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask6.fr: Le COTEAU SOMNOLENT : collines\nendormies pleines de POKéMON\lassoupis. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask7.en: The WEED PATCH: tall grass and tiny\nbugs. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask7.fr: Le MASSIF D'HERBES : hautes herbes\net minuscules insectes. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask8.en: The FOX FIELD: sly hunters in\ngolden grass. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask8.fr: Le CHAMP DES RENARDS : chasseurs\nrusés dans l'herbe dorée. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask9.en: The CROWN FIELD: the strongest wild\nPOKéMON gather here. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Ask9.fr: Le CHAMP DE LA COURONNE : les\nPOKéMON sauvages les plus forts s'y\lrassemblent. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Closed.en: The boat is not ready. Come back\nwhen the clocks make sense.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Closed.fr: Le bateau n'est pas prêt. Reviens\nquand les horloges auront un sens.

FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Hello.en: The master is busy. I row the small\ntrips, {PLAYER}.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Apprentice_Hello.fr: Le maître est occupé. Je ne fais\nque les petits trajets, {PLAYER}.

FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame.en: Did you try the SAFARI GAME?\pThere are some rare POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.
FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame.fr: As-tu essayé le JEU SAFARI ?\pCertains POKéMON rares ne peuvent\nêtre capturés que là-bas.

FuchsiaCity_Text_DockGuide0.en: Seven ferries leave from this dock.\nEchoes and time, tides and capture,\planterns and calm shores, babies\nand trades, dusk, the scribe and\pthe seasons. Ask them all.
FuchsiaCity_Text_DockGuide0.fr: Sept ferrys partent de ce port.\nÉchos et temps, marées et capture,\llanternes et rivages calmes, bébés\net échanges, crépuscule, scribe et\lsaisons. Demande-les tous.

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask0.en: The GROVE OF WHISPERS: spirits\ndrift between the trees. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask0.fr: Le BOSQUET DES MURMURES : des\nesprits dérivent entre les arbres.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask1.en: The SPARK GLADE hums with static.\nVisit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask1.fr: La CLAIRIÈRE ÉTINCELLE bourdonne\nd'électricité statique. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask10.en: The CENTER MEADOW: the old safari\ngrounds. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask10.fr: La PRAIRIE CENTRALE : l'ancien\nterrain du safari. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask11.en: The BERRY STAND: fresh berries for\nevery need. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask11.fr: Le STAND DE BAIES : baies fraîches\npour chaque besoin. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask12.en: The MIST LAKE: soft fog, calm\nwater. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask12.fr: Le LAC DE BRUME : brouillard doux,\neau calme. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask13.en: The FANG VALLEY: fierce hunters and\nsharp teeth. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask13.fr: La VALLÉE DES CROCS : chasseurs\nféroces et dents acérées. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask14.en: The SILENT HOLLOW: no wind, no\nsound. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask14.fr: Le CREUX SILENCIEUX : pas de vent,\npas de bruit. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask15.en: The IVY MAZE: twisting paths of\ngreen. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask15.fr: Le LABYRINTHE DE LIERRE : chemins\ntortueux de verdure. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask16.en: The STONE CIRCLE: dragons gather\nunder standing stones. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask16.fr: Le CERCLE DE PIERRES : les dragons\nse rassemblent sous les menhirs.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask17.en: The ASHEN HEIGHTS: warm rock and\nsmoking cracks. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask17.fr: Les HAUTEURS DE CENDRE : roche\nchaude et fissures fumantes.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask18.fr: La FALAISE DES BOURRASQUES :\nrochers fouettés par le vent.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask19.en: The MIRROR POND: still water,\nstrong swimmers. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask19.fr: L'ÉTANG MIROIR : eau calme, nageurs\npuissants. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask2.en: The DRAGON PERCH: the air is thin\nand the wings are large. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask2.fr: Le PERCHOIR DES DRAGONS : l'air est\nmince et les ailes sont grandes.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask20.en: The CINDER PLAIN: burnt grass, hot\nwinds. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask20.fr: La PLAINE DE CENDRES : herbe\nbrûlée, vents chauds. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask21.en: The EMBER RIDGE: warm rocks and red\nsparks. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask21.fr: La CRÊTE DE BRAISE : roches chaudes\net étincelles rouges. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask22.en: The DAWN SUMMIT: the first light of\nthe region. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask22.fr: Le SOMMET DE L'AUBE : la première\nlumière de la région. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask23.en: The TWILIGHT GLEN: everything is a\nshade of blue. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask23.fr: Le VALLON CRÉPUSCULAIRE : tout est\nd'une nuance de bleu. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask24.en: The RAINBOW FALLS: a rainbow, a\nwaterfall and big splashes. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask24.fr: Les CHUTES ARC-EN-CIEL : un\narc-en-ciel, une cascade et de gros\léclaboussements. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask25.en: The SUNSET ROAD: a long walk toward\nthe red sky. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask25.fr: La ROUTE DU COUCHANT : une longue\nmarche vers le ciel rouge.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask26.en: The ANCIENT LIBRARY: old books and\nolder minds. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask26.fr: L'ANCIENNE BIBLIOTHÈQUE : vieux\nlivres et esprits plus vieux.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask27.en: The GLIMMER BAY: the sea sparkles\nat noon. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask27.fr: La BAIE SCINTILLANTE : la mer\nbrille à midi. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask28.en: The MYTHIC SPRING: a pool that\ngrants wishes, they say. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask28.fr: La SOURCE MYTHIQUE : un bassin qui\nexauce les vœux, dit-on. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask29.en: The LAVA LAGOON: red water, hot\nair. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask29.fr: Le LAGON DE LAVE : eau rouge, air\nchaud. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask3.en: The ZEN GARDEN: still water, calm\nminds. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask3.fr: Le JARDIN ZEN : eau calme, esprits\nsereins. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask30.en: The CHAMPIONS PATH: only the best\nwalk here. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask30.fr: Le CHEMIN DES CHAMPIONS : seuls les\nmeilleurs y marchent. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask31.en: The VENOM SWAMP: the air itself\nbites. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask31.fr: Le MARAIS VENIMEUX : l'air lui-même\nmord. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask32.en: The ROYAL GARDEN: the most perfect\nhedges you will see. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask32.fr: Le JARDIN ROYAL : les haies les\nplus parfaites que tu verras.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask33.en: The SPIRE YARD: a graveyard around\na tall tower. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask33.fr: La COUR DE LA FLÈCHE : un cimetière\nautour d'une haute tour. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask34.en: The EDGE OF THE WORLD: the last\ncliff. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask34.fr: LE BOUT DU MONDE : la dernière\nfalaise. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask35.en: The SEA GLASS SHORE: green shards,\nsoft waves. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask35.fr: Le RIVAGE DE VERRE MARIN : éclats\nverts, vagues douces. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask36.en: The SKY GARDEN: flowers above the\nclouds. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask36.fr: Le JARDIN DU CIEL : des fleurs\nau-dessus des nuages. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask37.en: The ELECTRIC AVENUE: street lights\nthat bite. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask37.fr: L'AVENUE ÉLECTRIQUE : des\nlampadaires qui mordent. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask38.en: The FINAL GATE: beyond it, only\nlegends. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask38.fr: La PORTE FINALE : au-delà,\nseulement des légendes. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask4.en: The PLAIN OF GIANTS: wide grass and\nbig POKéMON. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask4.fr: La PLAINE DES GÉANTS : herbe\nétendue et gros POKéMON. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask5.en: The DUNE SEA: sand as far as the\neye can see. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask5.fr: La MER DE DUNES : du sable à perte\nde vue. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask6.en: The RUIN HOLLOW: old stones, older\nsecrets. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask6.fr: Le CREUX DES RUINES : vieilles\npierres, secrets plus vieux encore.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask7.en: The TIDE CAVE: deep water, strange\nlights. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask7.fr: La GROTTE DE LA MARÉE : eau\nprofonde, lumières étranges.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask8.en: The SOUL PILLAR: the quiet place of\nremembrance. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask8.fr: Le PILIER DES ÂMES : le lieu calme\ndu souvenir. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask9.en: The OUTCAST SHORE: wild waters,\nwild POKéMON. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Ask9.fr: Le RIVAGE DES EXILÉS : eaux\nsauvages, POKéMON sauvages.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Closed.en: The dusk is not ready. Come back\nwhen the clocks make sense.
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Closed.fr: Le crépuscule n'est pas prêt.\nReviens quand les horloges auront\lun sens.

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Hello.en: At dusk the strangest places open,\n{PLAYER}.
FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Hello.fr: Au crépuscule, les endroits les\nplus étranges s'ouvrent, {PLAYER}.

FuchsiaCity_Text_DuskFerrywoman_Never.en: Another time. Dusk will come again.

FuchsiaCity_Text_FerryLocked.en: Some places need more BADGES. Come\nback later.
FuchsiaCity_Text_FerryLocked.fr: Certains lieux nécessitent plus de\nBADGES. Reviens plus tard.

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask0.en: The old LIGHTHOUSE? Its lamp turns\nbackwards. Want to see it?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask0.fr: Le vieux PHARE ? Sa lampe tourne à\nl'envers. Tu veux le voir ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask1.en: The CLOCK BEACH? Every wave brings\nin a broken clock. Want to see it?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask1.fr: La PLAGE DES HORLOGES ? Chaque\nvague apporte une horloge cassée.\pTu veux la voir ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask2.en: A village where today never ends?\nDo you want to go?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask2.fr: Un village où aujourd'hui ne finit\njamais ? Veux-tu y aller ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask3.en: The BOTTOMLESS CAVE? Every time you\ngo down, the floor count changes.\pBrave enough?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask3.fr: La GROTTE SANS FOND ? Chaque fois\nque tu descends, le nombre d'étages\lchange.\pAssez courageux ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask4.en: The GARDEN OF ECHOES blooms with\nwhat the ECHOES left behind. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask4.fr: Le JARDIN DES ÉCHOS fleurit de ce\nque les ÉCHOS ont laissé. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask5.en: The ISLAND OF THE LAST DAY... no\none has come back from there\punchanged. Go anyway?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask5.fr: L'ÎLE DU DERNIER JOUR… personne\nn'en est revenu inchangé. Y aller\lquand même ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask6.en: A clearing where your friends rest\nbetween battles. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Ask6.fr: Une clairière où tes amis se\nreposent entre les combats.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Closed.en: The ferry is not running. The\nclocks of the routes are still\punread. Come back when you know why\nthey stopped.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Closed.fr: Le ferry ne circule pas. Les\nhorloges des routes sont encore\lillisibles. Reviens quand tu sauras\npourquoi elles se sont arrêtées.

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Hello.en: I row where time runs differently.\nWhere do you want to go, {PLAYER}?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Hello.fr: Je rame là où le temps s'écoule\ndifféremment. Où veux-tu aller,\l{PLAYER} ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Never.en: Another time, then. The tide will\nwait.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Ferry_Never.fr: Une autre fois, alors. La marée\nattendra.

FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign.en: AMETHIOLITE POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ACHLYS\lThe Violet Venom Witch!
FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign.fr: ARÈNE POKéMON D'AMETHIOLITE\nCHAMPIONNE : ACHLYS\lLa Sorcière du Venin Violet !

FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere.en: That item ball in there…\nWere you wanting that?\pMe, too!\n…Huh? That's a POKéMON?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere.fr: Cette Ball dans le coin…\nTu la voulais ?\pMoi aussi !\n…Hein ? C'est un POKéMON ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask0.en: The WEST RESERVE, home of POKéMON\nfrom a far region. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask0.fr: La RÉSERVE OUEST, foyer de POKéMON\nd'une région lointaine. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask1.en: The EAST RESERVE: sea and cliffs\nfrom a far region. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask1.fr: La RÉSERVE EST : mer et falaises\nd'une région lointaine. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask2.en: The SUNRISE MEADOW: POKéMON from\nthe other side of the sea. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask2.fr: La PRAIRIE DU LEVANT : POKéMON de\nl'autre côté de la mer. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask3.en: The ASHEN MINE: gems, stones, odd\nPOKéMON. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask3.fr: La MINE DE CENDRE : gemmes,\npierres, POKéMON étranges.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask4.en: The BERRY ORCHARD grows every kind\nof berry. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask4.fr: Le VERGER DE BAIES fait pousser\ntoutes les sortes de baies.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask5.en: The DOCK CAFE: rest, a drink and a\nchat. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask5.fr: Le CAFÉ DU QUAI : repos, boisson et\ndiscussion. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask6.en: The EVOLUTION LIBRARY: every way a\nPOKéMON can change. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask6.fr: La BIBLIOTHÈQUE DE L'ÉVOLUTION :\ntoutes les façons dont un POKéMON\lpeut changer. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask7.en: The COLLECTOR SHOP: little\ntreasures for sale. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Ask7.fr: La BOUTIQUE DU COLLECTIONNEUR :\npetits trésors à vendre. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Closed.en: The lantern is lit only for those\nwho read the clocks.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Closed.fr: La lanterne n'est allumée que pour\nceux qui lisent les horloges.

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Hello.en: My lantern lights the way to calmer\nplaces, {PLAYER}.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Hello.fr: Ma lanterne éclaire le chemin vers\ndes lieux plus calmes, {PLAYER}.

FuchsiaCity_Text_Lantern_Never.fr: Une autre fois. La lanterne reste\nallumée.

FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonChansey.en: CHANSEY: Chansey! Chansey!\pIt escaped from the zoo, and does\nnot seem to want to go back.
FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonChansey.fr: LEVEINARD : Chansey ! Chansey !\pIl s'est échappé du zoo, et ne\nsemble pas vouloir y retourner.

FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonKangaskhan.en: KANGASKHAN: Garuu!\pIt escaped from the zoo, and does\nnot seem to want to go back.
FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonKangaskhan.fr: KANGOUREX : Garuu !\pIl s'est échappé du zoo, et ne\nsemble pas vouloir y retourner.

FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonPsyduck.en: PSYDUCK: Psy... duck?\pIt escaped from the zoo, and does\nnot seem to want to go back.
FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonPsyduck.fr: PSYKOKWAK : Psy… duck ?\pIl s'est échappé du zoo, et ne\nsemble pas vouloir y retourner.

FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonSlowpoke.en: SLOWPOKE: ...Yawn?\pIt escaped from the zoo, and does\nnot seem to want to go back.
FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonSlowpoke.fr: RAMOLOSS : …Bâillement ?\pIl s'est échappé du zoo, et ne\nsemble pas vouloir y retourner.

FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonVoltorb.en: VOLTORB: Zzzt!\pIt escaped from the zoo, and does\nnot seem to want to go back.
FuchsiaCity_Text_LooseMonVoltorb.fr: VOLTORBE : Zzzt !\pIl s'est échappé du zoo, et ne\nsemble pas vouloir y retourner.

FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader.en: My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\pI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.
FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader.fr: Mon père est le CHAMPION de cette\nville.\pJe m'entraîne à utiliser les\nPOKéMON POISON aussi bien que mon\lpère.

FuchsiaCity_Text_PoliceBadge.en: The thieves slipped away, so we\nkeep watch. Only trainers who can\lprove themselves may pass.\pBeat the GYM LEADER first, kid.
FuchsiaCity_Text_PoliceBadge.fr: Les voleurs se sont échappés, alors\nnous montons la garde. Seuls les\ldresseurs qui ont fait leurs\npreuves peuvent passer.\pBats d'abord le CHAMPION.

FuchsiaCity_Text_PoliceRaid.en: Sorry, the town is sealed until the\nzoo POKéMON are rounded up.\pThieves are on the loose. Nobody\ngoes in or out this way.
FuchsiaCity_Text_PoliceRaid.fr: Désolé, la ville est fermée tant\nque les POKéMON du zoo ne sont pas\lrattrapés.\pDes voleurs sont en liberté.\nPersonne n'entre ni ne sort par\lici.

FuchsiaCity_Text_PoliceVolcano.en: The sea road south is closed.\pThe SEAFOAM volcano erupted and\nthe water is molten rock.\pLooking for CHRONDROLIA? Go back\nto GRENALUX and SURF south.
FuchsiaCity_Text_PoliceVolcano.fr:
La route maritime du sud est
fermée.\pLe volcan SEAFOAM est entré en
éruption et l'eau est de la roche\len fusion.\pTu cherches CHRONDROLIA ? Retourne
à GRENALUX et SURF vers le sud.

FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_After.en: The sea is calm now. Thanks for the\nfight, {PLAYER}.
FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_After.fr: La mer est calme maintenant. Merci\npour le combat, {PLAYER}.

FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_Early.en: Not yet, {PLAYER}. Finish your\njourney first, then come and find\pme.
FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_Early.fr: Pas encore, {PLAYER}. Termine\nd'abord ton voyage, puis viens me\ltrouver.

FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_Intro.en: {PLAYER}! The tide is perfect today.\nCome, ride the wave with me!
FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_Intro.fr: {PLAYER} ! La marée est parfaite\naujourd'hui. Viens, chevauche la\lvague avec moi !

FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_NoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make some room\nfirst, then talk to me again.
FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_NoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reparle-moi.

FuchsiaCity_Text_ProcheThibault_Win.en: From the deep. A gift for you.

FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront.en: The SAFARI ZONE has a zoo in front\nof the entrance.\pOut back is the SAFARI GAME for\ncatching POKéMON.
FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront.fr: Le PARC SAFARI a un zoo devant\nl'entrée.\pÀ l'arrière se trouve le JEU SAFARI\npour capturer des POKéMON.

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask0.en: The HALL OF THE POKéDEX: rewards\nfor every milestone. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask0.fr: Le HALL DU POKéDEX : des\nrécompenses à chaque palier.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask1.en: The THORN THICKET: bugs of every\nkind hide here. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask1.fr: Le FOURRÉ ÉPINEUX : des insectes de\ntoutes sortes s'y cachent.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask10.en: The NORTH WIND: bitter gusts and\ncold fur. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask10.fr: Le VENT DU NORD : rafales amères et\nfourrure froide. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask11.en: The MOSSY DELL: old trees and\nPikachu. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask11.fr: Le VALLON MOUSSU : vieux arbres et\nPikachu. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask12.en: The HUSHED BOG: slime, mist and\npoison types. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask12.fr: Le MARÉCAGE FEUTRÉ : vase, brume et\ntypes POISON. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask13.en: The OBSIDIAN PASS: black rock and\nheavy hitters. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask13.fr: Le COL D'OBSIDIENNE : roche noire\net gros cogneurs. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask14.en: The HONEY GROVE: sweet air and busy\nwings. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask14.fr: Le BOSQUET DE MIEL : air sucré et\nailes affairées. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask15.en: The FROZEN MARSH: ice on the reeds.\nVisit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask15.fr: Le MARAIS GELÉ : glace sur les\nroseaux. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask16.en: The RUSTY YARD: old scrap and new\nfriends. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask16.fr: La COUR ROUILLÉE : vieille\nferraille et nouveaux amis.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask17.en: The GLASS CAVERN: shining walls and\nsharp echoes. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask17.fr: La CAVERNE DE VERRE : murs\nbrillants et échos tranchants.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask18.en: The PINE ROW: tall trunks and quiet\nneedles. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask18.fr: La RANGÉE DE PINS : hauts troncs et\naiguilles silencieuses. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask19.en: The STEEL GARDEN: metal flowers\nthat never wilt. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask19.fr: Le JARDIN D'ACIER : des fleurs de\nmétal qui ne fanent jamais.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask2.en: The KINDLE TRAIL: a training path\nfor fighters. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask2.fr: Le SENTIER BRAISE : un parcours\nd'entraînement pour combattants.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask20.en: The MUDDY CREEK: brown water and\nslippery friends. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask20.fr: Le RUISSEAU BOUEUX : eau brune et\namis glissants. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask21.en: The THUNDER PLAIN: static in the\nair. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask21.fr: La PLAINE DU TONNERRE : statique\ndans l'air. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask22.en: The HAUNTED ORCHARD: the apples\nwhisper. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask22.fr: Le VERGER HANTÉ : les pommes\nchuchotent. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask23.en: The IRON FOREST: leaves like\nblades. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask23.fr: La FORÊT DE FER : des feuilles\ncomme des lames. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask24.en: The MARBLE HALL: a quiet gallery\nopen to the sky. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask24.fr: La SALLE DE MARBRE : une galerie\ntranquille ouverte sur le ciel.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask25.en: The SLEEPY HOLLOW: naps are\nmandatory. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask25.fr: Le CREUX ENDORMI : les siestes sont\nobligatoires. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask26.en: The CLIFFSIDE COVE: a hidden beach\nunder the rocks. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask26.fr: La CRIQUE DE LA FALAISE : une plage\ncachée sous les rochers. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask27.en: The WINDMILL FLATS: wide fields and\nslow blades. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask27.fr: Les PLAINES DES MOULINS : vastes\nchamps et pales lentes. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask28.en: The PRAIRIE DUSK: tall grass,\norange sky. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask28.fr: La PRAIRIE DU CRÉPUSCULE : herbe\nhaute, ciel orange. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask29.en: The QUARTZ QUARRY: pale rock and\nloud hammers. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask29.fr: La CARRIÈRE DE QUARTZ : roche pâle\net marteaux bruyants. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask3.en: The MIRROR BRIDGE: calm water, calm\nreflections. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask3.fr: Le PONT MIROIR : eau calme, reflets\ncalmes. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask30.en: The MIRROR MARSH: still water that\ncopies the sky. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask30.fr: Le MARAIS MIROIR : une eau calme\nqui copie le ciel. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask31.en: The DEEP EMBER CAVE: hot stone,\nhotter echoes. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask31.fr: La GROTTE DE BRAISE PROFONDE :\nroche chaude, échos plus chauds.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask32.en: The PUDDLE LANE: it rained. It\nalways rains. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask32.fr: La RUELLE AUX FLAQUES : il a plu.\nIl pleut toujours. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask33.en: The SPIRIT FALLS: a waterfall with\na voice. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask33.fr: Les CHUTES DES ESPRITS : une\ncascade qui a une voix. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask4.en: The QUARRY HEIGHTS: rock, steel and\nhard heads. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask4.fr: Les HAUTEURS DE LA CARRIÈRE :\nroche, acier et têtes dures.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask5.en: The BATTLE STALL: small boosts for\nhard fights. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask5.fr: Le STAND DE COMBAT : petits boosts\npour combats difficiles. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask6.en: The STARLIT STEPPE: wide plains\nunder a thousand stars. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask6.fr: La STEPPE ÉTOILÉE : vastes plaines\nsous mille étoiles. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask7.en: The BLOSSOM CREST: a hill covered\nin flowers. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask7.fr: La CRÊTE FLEURIE : une colline\ncouverte de fleurs. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask8.en: The LUCKY CLOVER: normal types, big\nhearts. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask8.fr: Le TRÈFLE PORTE-BONHEUR : types\nNORMAL, grands cœurs. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask9.en: The SKY PERCH: cliffs for birds and\nwind riders. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Ask9.fr: Le PERCHOIR DU CIEL : falaises pour\noiseaux et chevaucheurs de vent.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Closed.en: The ledger is closed. Come back\nwhen the clocks make sense.
FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Closed.fr: Le registre est fermé. Reviens\nquand les horloges auront un sens.

FuchsiaCity_Text_ScribeFerryman_Hello.en: The scribe waits for you with his\nledger, {PLAYER}.

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask0.en: The FROST HOLLOW: ice, silence and\ncold POKéMON. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask0.fr: Le CREUX GIVRÉ : glace, silence et\nPOKéMON de froid. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask1.en: The EMBER RIM: lava glows below the\nrock. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask1.fr: Le BORD DE BRAISE : la lave luit\nsous la roche. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask10.en: The THUNDER RIDGE: static in the\nair, storms on the horizon. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask10.fr: La CRÊTE DU TONNERRE : statique\ndans l'air, orages à l'horizon.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask11.en: The SANDBOX GROVE: a sandy\nplayground for ground types. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask11.fr: Le BOSQUET DU BAC À SABLE : un\nterrain de jeu sablonneux pour\ltypes SOL. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask12.en: The BRIGHT SHALLOWS: warm water,\neasy fishing. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask12.fr: Les BAS-FONDS LUMINEUX : eau\nchaude, pêche facile. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask13.en: The SOUND MEADOW: songs, echoes and\nNormal types. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask13.fr: La PRAIRIE SONORE : chants, échos\net types NORMAL. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask14.en: The PHANTOM LANE: a road for ghosts\nand shadows. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask14.fr: La RUELLE FANTÔME : une route pour\nfantômes et ombres. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask15.en: The CIRCUS LAWN: psychic acts and\nstrange shows. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask15.fr: La PELOUSE DU CIRQUE : numéros psy\net spectacles étranges. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask16.en: The THORNY TRAIL: a sharp path for\nsharp teeth. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask16.fr: Le SENTIER ÉPINEUX : un chemin\ntranchant pour dents tranchantes.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask17.en: The WILLOW BANK: a slow river and\ncalm shade. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask17.fr: La BERGE DES SAULES : une rivière\nlente et une ombre calme. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask18.en: The SALTY DUNES: sand, wind and sea\nspray. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask18.fr: Les DUNES SALÉES : sable, vent et\nembruns. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask19.en: The CRYSTAL GROTTO: gems in every\nwall. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask19.fr: La GROTTE DE CRISTAL : des gemmes\ndans chaque mur. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask2.en: The NOCTURNE WOOD: the owls sing\nall day long. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask2.fr: Le BOIS NOCTURNE : les hiboux\nchantent toute la journée.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask20.en: The COPPER CANYON: red walls and\necho. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask20.fr: Le CANYON DE CUIVRE : murs rouges\net écho. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask21.en: The BONEYARD RISE: old bones, old\nstories. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask21.fr: La BUTTE DES OSSEMENTS : vieux os,\nvieilles histoires. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask22.en: The METEOR FIELD: craters and star\ndust. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask22.fr: Le CHAMP DE MÉTÉORITES : cratères\net poussière d'étoiles. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask23.en: The CORAL TERRACE: stone steps\nbuilt by the tide. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask23.fr: La TERRASSE DE CORAIL : marches de\npierre bâties par la marée.\lVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask24.en: The HIGH PINES: thin air and strong\nbugs. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask24.fr: Les HAUTS PINS : air mince et\ninsectes forts. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask25.en: The GRANITE BLUFF: heavy stone and\nheavy boots. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask25.fr: Le PROMONTOIRE DE GRANIT : pierre\nlourde et grosses bottes. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask3.en: The SHELL COAST: the tide leaves\ntreasure behind. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask3.fr: La CÔTE AUX COQUILLAGES : la marée\nlaisse des trésors derrière elle.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask4.en: The EEVEE GROVE: every shade of one\nfamily lives here. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask4.fr: Le BOSQUET D'ÉVOLI : toutes les\nnuances d'une même famille y\lvivent. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask5.en: The PROFESSOR'S RESERVE: first\npartners run free here. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask5.fr: La RÉSERVE DU PROFESSEUR : les\npremiers partenaires courent\llibrement. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask6.en: The SUNKEN BEACH: shells, sand and\nearly water types. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask6.fr: La PLAGE ENGLOUTIE : coquillages,\nsable et premiers types EAU.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask7.en: The POND OF SONG: frogs, ducks and\ngentle ripples. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask7.fr: L'ÉTANG DU CHANT : grenouilles,\ncanards et douces ondulations.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask8.en: The BALL BOUTIQUE: rare balls for\nkeen collectors. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask8.fr: La BOUTIQUE DES BALLS : des balls\nrares pour collectionneurs\lpassionnés. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask9.en: The SALT FLATS: dry crust and\nbright shores. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Ask9.fr: Les SALINES : croûte sèche et\nrivages éclatants. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Closed.en: The seasons are frozen. Come back\nwhen the clocks make sense.
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Closed.fr: Les saisons sont figées. Reviens\nquand les horloges auront un sens.

FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Hello.en: Each season has its own shore,\n{PLAYER}.
FuchsiaCity_Text_SeasonsFerryman_Hello.fr: Chaque saison a son propre rivage,\n{PLAYER}.

FuchsiaCity_Text_StafferAlarm.en:
Help! Men in black burst into the
zoo and threw open every cage!\pPOKéMON are running loose, and
they went for the WARDEN's HOUSE!\pHis AMETHIOLITE is on display
there. Please, stop them!
FuchsiaCity_Text_StafferAlarm.fr:
Au secours ! Des hommes en noir ont
fait irruption dans le zoo et\louvert toutes les cages !\pDes POKéMON courent en liberté, et
ils ont filé vers la MAISON DU\lGARDIEN !\pSon AMETHIOLITE y est exposée. S'il
vous plaît, arrêtez-les !

FuchsiaCity_Text_TQ_Ask.en: A SITRUS BERRY would warm me up. I\nwill pay in charcoal.
FuchsiaCity_Text_TQ_Ask.fr: Une BAIE CITRON me réchaufferait.\nJe paierai en charbon.

FuchsiaCity_Text_TQ_NoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
FuchsiaCity_Text_TQ_NoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask0.en: The MARSH OF REFLECTIONS shows what\nPOKéMON could become, or were.\pVisit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask0.fr: Le MARAIS DES REFLETS montre ce que\nles POKéMON pourraient devenir, ou\lont été.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask1.en: The STONE GREENHOUSE grows POKéMON\nthat wait for a stone. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask1.fr: La SERRE DE PIERRE fait pousser les\nPOKéMON qui attendent une pierre.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask2.en: The TRADE DOCK, where POKéMON that\nevolve by trade wait on the pier.\pVisit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask2.fr: Le QUAI D'ÉCHANGE, où les POKéMON\nqui évoluent par échange attendent\lsur la jetée.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask3.en: The FOSSIL DIG: five fossils sleep\nin the sand. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask3.fr: Les FOUILLES DE FOSSILES : cinq\nfossiles dorment dans le sable.\pVisiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask4.en: The POND OF CYCLES: water, patience\nand rare catches. Visit?
FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Ask4.fr: L'ÉTANG DES CYCLES : eau, patience\net captures rares. Visiter ?

FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Closed.en: The tide is not ready. Come back\nonce the clocks make sense.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Closed.fr: La marée n'est pas prête. Reviens\nquand les horloges auront un sens.

FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Hello.en: I row to places where POKéMON\ngather to become something else,\p{PLAYER}.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Hello.fr: Je rame vers des lieux où les\nPOKéMON se rassemblent pour devenir\lautre chose, {PLAYER}.

FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Never.en: Another time, then. The tide can\nwait.
FuchsiaCity_Text_Tide_Never.fr: Une autre fois, alors. La marée\npeut attendre.

FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara.en: ERIK: Where's SARA?\nI said I'd meet her here.
FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara.fr: ERIK : Où est SARA ? J'avais dit\nque je la retrouverais ici.

Text_SubstituteDeclined.fr: Oh, vraiment ?\nCLONAGE a l'air si amusant…

Text_SubstituteTaught.en: Boy, what I'd give to crawl inside\na KANGASKHAN belly pouch…
Text_SubstituteTaught.fr: Ah, ce que je donnerais pour me\nglisser dans la poche d'un\lKANGOUREX…

Text_SubstituteTeach.en:
Aww, I wish I was a KANGASKHAN
baby.\pI'd love to be a substitute for the
baby…\pAnd snuggle in the mother
KANGASKHAN's belly pouch.\pBut only POKéMON can use the
technique SUBSTITUTE…\pWant me to teach SUBSTITUTE to
one of your POKéMON?
Text_SubstituteTeach.fr:
Aww, j'aimerais être un bébé
KANGOUREX.\pJ'adorerais remplacer le bébé…\pEt me blottir dans la poche
ventrale de la mère KANGOUREX.\pMais seuls les POKéMON peuvent
utiliser la technique CLONAGE…\pVeux-tu que j'apprenne CLONAGE à
un de tes POKéMON ?
